title: TLS 1.3 & X.509 Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) Guide
description: A comprehensive course on asymmetric cryptography, TLS 1.3 handshakes, X.509 certificate chains, OpenSSL automation, ACME certbot renewals, and Go mTLS.
body: Master Public Key Infrastructure (PKI). Learn TLS 1.3 1-RTT handshake mechanics, certificate authority chains (Root CA -> Intermediate CA -> Leaf Cert), OpenSSL CLI command usage, and mutual TLS (mTLS) enforcement.

lessons.title: Lesson 1.1: TLS 1.3 1-RTT Handshake Architecture
lessons.body:
### 1-RTT Latency Reduction
TLS 1.3 combines key exchange (ECDHE) and cipher agreement into ClientHello, reducing handshake latency to a single round trip.

lessons.title: Lesson 1.2: X.509 Certificate Chain Hierarchy
lessons.body: Understanding Root CAs, Intermediate CAs, Leaf Server Certificates, and CRL / OCSP revocation checks.

sections.title: Section 2: Production OpenSSL & Go mTLS Implementation

lessons.title: Lesson 2.1: OpenSSL CLI Certificate Management Cheatsheet
lessons.body:
```bash
# Generate RSA 4096-bit private key
openssl genrsa -out server.key 4096

# Generate Certificate Signing Request (CSR)
openssl req -new -key server.key -out server.csr -subj "/CN=api.geekgully.local"

# Generate self-signed certificate
openssl x509 -req -days 365 -in server.csr -signkey server.key -out server.crt
```

lessons.title: Lesson 2.2: Enforcing Mutual TLS (mTLS) in Go Backend Microservices
lessons.body: Configure tls.Config with ClientAuth: tls.RequireAndVerifyClientCert to enforce zero-trust service-to-service mTLS.
